title: Field Papers: Private Instructions
text:
PRIVATE

You already hold my commission. Conduct yourself as a civilian. These papers confer no public rank. Do not claim Embassy protection to settle a private quarrel.

Read these papers and file an acknowledgment with your orders. Reports travel with the next dispatch; replies require a full day.

Ordinary observation is permitted. Disclosure, political commitments, and the removal of persons are separate decisions. Permission concerning one case says nothing about another.

Your work precedes any distinction Skyrim may later confer upon you. Remember that.

Elenwen

title: Confidential Commission
text:
For the bearer alone

Your existing appointment as a confidential field officer remains in force. Maintain your civilian identity and report by the agreed channel. The enclosed one hundred septims are an initial allowance, not an advance against a claim.

Do not present yourself as a uniformed member of my delegation, promise favors in my name, or treat personal acquaintance as operational authority. Further instructions await at the secure box. Audiences are by summons.

Elenwen
First Emissary

title: Filed Request: Supply Advance
text:
Instruction 1002

I request authority to draw an eighty-septim advance for the spiced wine purchase. The allowable expense remains thirty septims. Unused funds will be returned within fourteen days of collection.

Filed by secure dispatch.

title: Authorization 1002: Supply Advance
text:
Instruction 1002 only

You may draw eighty septims from Accounts while the purchase remains open. This is an advance, not an increase in the thirty-septim allowance.

It grants no authority to disclose protected information, make political commitments, or remove any person.

Elenwen

title: Accounts: Advance Receipt
text:
Instruction 1002

Eighty septims issued as an operational advance. Approved costs settle this sum before any cash reimbursement. Return the unused balance within fourteen days.

Personal spending from the advance remains payable by the bearer.

title: Accounts: Funds Returned
text:
Funds were received against the bearer's outstanding advance and operational liability. The current balance is available at the dispatch box.

This acknowledgment does not authorize another advance.

title: Accounts: Overdue Advance
text:
Instruction 1002

The fourteen-day accounting period has expired. Unreturned funds are now the bearer's liability, and further advances are suspended while money remains due.

Return the funds through dispatch. A valid later claim may discharge recognized costs against this balance.

title: Claim 1002: Wine, Thirty Septims
text:
Declared cost: thirty septims. Purpose: purchase of the delivered Solitude spiced wine. Payee: seller declared by the bearer.

This declaration is submitted for Accounts review. It is not independent proof of a purchase.

title: Claim 1002: Wine, Eighty Septims
text:
Declared cost: eighty septims. Purpose: purchase of the delivered Solitude spiced wine. Payee: seller declared by the bearer.

This exceeds the written thirty-septim allowance and requires review.

title: Claim 1002: Personal Gift
text:
Declared cost: thirty septims. Purpose: a personal gift the bearer associates with the wine purchase.

No instruction required this gift. Its inclusion is expressly disclosed.

title: Claim 1002: Meal
text:
Declared cost: thirty septims. Purpose: a meal during the wine purchase.

The connection to the instruction has not been explained. No reimbursement is presumed.

title: Accounts Decision: Approved
text:
Instruction 1002

The declared thirty-septim expense is allowed. Recognized costs first settle an advance or audited liability; any balance due to the bearer is paid on collection. This decision may be used once only.

The cost stayed within the instruction. That is the standard.

Elenwen

title: Accounts Decision: Partially Approved
text:
Instruction 1002

Of the eighty septims declared for the wine, thirty are allowed. The excess of fifty is personal expenditure, and any part of it paid from the advance is owed to Accounts. Consult the statement for the settlement.

An advance was permission to draw funds, not to ignore a ceiling.

Elenwen

title: Accounts Decision: Denied
text:
Instruction 1002

Personal expenditure is not chargeable to the Embassy. Any portion drawn from the advance is due from the bearer.

You were sent to buy wine. Your generosity is your own affair, and so is its cost.

Elenwen

title: Accounts Decision: Explanation Required
text:
Instruction 1002

The meal claim is returned without settlement. State whether it was a necessary meeting with the seller or personal entertainment, and file the explanation at the dispatch box. No money is paid by this letter.

The fourteen-day obligation to account for any advance is not suspended. A later accepted explanation may discharge recognized costs against an audited liability.

A meal does not become Embassy business because it occurred during an errand.

Elenwen

title: Filed Explanation: Seller Meeting
text:
Instruction 1002

The bearer declares that the meal was a necessary meeting with the wine seller, not personal entertainment. Thirty septims are claimed; no more than fifteen are allowable.

Submitted for Accounts review. A decision follows by return dispatch.

title: Filed Explanation: Personal Entertainment
text:
Instruction 1002

The bearer declares that the thirty-septim meal was personal entertainment. No instruction required it.

Submitted for Accounts review. A decision follows by return dispatch.

title: Accounts Decision: Meal Allowance
text:
Instruction 1002

Fifteen septims of the thirty-septim meal are allowed. The remaining fifteen are personal expenditure. Recognized costs first settle any advance or audited liability; the remainder is reimbursed on collection.

A necessary meeting may justify a modest expense. It does not justify the whole bill.

Elenwen

title: Filed Docket: Closing Review
text:
Instructions 1001-1012

Every instruction in this series is closed and its response collected. The filing dates and Accounts record are submitted for the First Emissary's review. Her response follows by the next dispatch.

This docket requests no payment or change in public standing.

title: Private Assessment: Dependable Service
text:
Instructions 1001-1012

The series is closed. The record shows no missed deadline and no adverse finding from Accounts.

You did what you were told, when you were told. Your commission continues on its existing terms; this letter confers no rank and no further authority.

Elenwen

title: Private Assessment: Further Care Required
text:
Instructions 1001-1012

The series is closed and the work accepted. The record also shows one lapse: a missed deadline, or an expense Accounts would not fully allow.

One lapse is a matter of care. Two would be a matter of reliability. Your commission continues; this letter confers no further authority.

Elenwen

title: Private Assessment: Formal Reprimand
text:
Instructions 1001-1012

The series is closed. I have accepted the work, but the record warrants a reprimand: more than one missed deadline, money still owed, an overdue advance, or a denied expense.

Any sum shown as outstanding is to be returned through Accounts. Accepting your reports does not cancel it.

Your commission continues. Future instructions will be read with this letter beside them.

Elenwen
